experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Upgraded a microservice application across 20 Java modules from Spring Boot 2.6 to Spring Boot 3.5, redesigning security configuration for Spring Security 6, migrating Jakarta APIs, and upgrading five generated API-client modules.

Designed and implemented REST and gRPC APIs for cross-product communication, with pagination, filtering, audit information, and backward-compatible Protocol Buffer contracts validated through contract-style tests.

Built Ember.js/TypeScript configuration and reporting workflows with reusable multiselect components, input validation, and conditional rendering; consolidated logic and removed redundant service calls.
Implemented concurrency controls for long-running jobs using centralized mutation guards and dedicated status APIs; connected backend state to progress tracking and conflict handling in the frontend.
Optimized MongoDB data access using targeted indexes, bulk reads, and batched audit retrieval; developed migration logic to transform and upsert legacy records.
